name: Upper Egypt
alt: Southern kingdom of the First Intermediate Period

predecessors.name: Old Kingdom of Egypt
predecessors.text: the nome of Thebes, whose nomarch Intef the Elder was 'keeper of the Door of the South'

successors.name: Middle Kingdom of Egypt
successors.text: the Theban kingdom from Elephantine north to Abydos and the edge of Middle Egypt

ledger.x: c. 2134 BC: the Theban Eleventh Dynasty begins in Upper Egypt. Infobox 'Thebes (c. 2134 BC - c. 2061 BC), Eleventh Dynasty of Egypt'; Intef the Elder was 'the nomarch of Thebes, often called the keeper of the Door of the South', who 'did not appear to have tried to claim the title of king'. The page names the city…

c. 2069 BC: Thebes attacks Abydos. 'One of them, Intef II, begins the assault on the north, particularly at Abydos.' No year on the page; placed at the start of Intef III's reign in the infobox ('c. 2069 BC - c. 2061 BC').

c. 2061 BC: Intef III takes Abydos. 'His successor, Intef III, completed the conquest of Abydos, moving into Middle Egypt against the Heracleopolitan kings.' Undated on the page; placed at the end of the Theban dynasty's c. 2061 BC date.
c. 2061 BC: the Abydos fighting ends with the Theban conquest.

By c. 2060 BC (placed in -2061): Thebes defeats the governor of Nekhen and extends to Elephantine. 'By around 2060 BC, Intef II had defeated the governor of Nekhen, allowing further expansion south, toward Elephantine.' The Aswan governorate is the researcher's reading of 'toward Elephantine'. Counterpart nobody…

c. 2055 BC: the Theban kingdom becomes the Middle Kingdom. 'The struggle was to be concluded by Mentuhotep II, who ascended the Theban throne in 2055 BC'; the First Intermediate Period page ends the period 'c. 2055 BC'. Same state under the Middle Kingdom's name; the conquest of the north follows…

wars.name: Theban-Heracleopolitan war
wars.outcome: Intef II began the assault on Abydos and Intef III completed its conquest; the war goes on under Mentuhotep II (see lower-egypt and middle-kingdom-of-egypt).

wars.name: Ankhtifi's attack on Thebes
wars.outcome: Ankhtifi, nomarch of Hierakonpolis, 'tried to expand to the north to conquer the nome centred on Thebes, but was unsuccessful'; Thebes later beat the governor of Nekhen (c.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey borders; the Theban core and the later strip are approximate.
